name: contract_elements
description: Complete factual statements about contract formation, defenses, remedies and negligence elements from a fixed legal fact table; controls complete nonlegal scientific facts in identical formats.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
legal=[('The bargained-for exchange of value in a contract is called','consideration'),('An unqualified assent to an offer is called','acceptance'),('A proposal that invites assent to form a contract is called an','offer'),('An enforceable agreement between parties is a','contract'),('Failure to perform a contractual obligation is a','breach'),('Monetary compensation for breach of contract is called','damages'),('A contract induced by an unlawful threat may be avoided for','duress'),('A contract induced by a deliberate material lie may be avoided for','fraud'),('A new proposal that changes the terms of an offer is a','counteroffer'),('Withdrawal of an offer before acceptance is called','revocation'),('A mutual cancellation restoring parties to their pre-contract positions is','rescission'),('The obligation to take reasonable steps to reduce avoidable losses is the duty to','mitigate'),('A failure to exercise reasonable care is','negligence'),('The first element of negligence is a duty of','care'),('The causal link between breach and injury is called','causation'),('The court remedy compelling performance of a contract is specific','performance')]
control=[('The process by which plants convert light into chemical energy is','photosynthesis'),('The organ that pumps blood through the body is the','heart'),('The force attracting masses toward one another is','gravity'),('The closest star to Earth is the','sun'),('A geometric figure with three sides is a','triangle'),('The largest planet in the solar system is','Jupiter'),('Water in its solid state is called','ice'),('The conversion of liquid water to vapor is','evaporation'),('The conversion of vapor to liquid water is','condensation'),('The natural satellite of Earth is the','moon'),('The chemical element with atomic number one is','hydrogen'),('The chemical element with symbol Fe is','iron'),('An animal that eats only plants is a','herbivore'),('The basic unit of life is the','cell'),('The gas plants absorb during photosynthesis is carbon','dioxide'),('The center of an atom is called the','nucleus')]
frames=['{s}','Complete the statement with the missing term.\n{s}','Fill in the final term:\n{s}','Study notes:\n{s}','Vocabulary review:\n{s}']
def make(table):
 rows=[{'prompt':f.format(s=s),'answer':' '+a} for f in frames for s,a in table];random.shuffle(rows);return rows
json.dump({'items':make(legal),'control':make(control)},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
